observation.visible_scene: A nighttime outdoor scene lit by a single bright orange street lamp mounted on a curved pole at right-center. A dark silhouetted utility pole with a T-shaped crossarm stands at left-center, with a smaller distant light glowing below it. Masses of trees frame the left and right edges, some left-side leaves catching the lamp light. Rain is visible as fine diagonal streaks falling through the lamp's halo, and numerous small bright specks are scattered within the right-side foliage.
visible_changes: Rain streaks fall continuously and diagonally through the illuminated halo around the lamp across all frames.
The small bright specks embedded in the right tree foliage shift position and flicker in and out from frame to frame.
The lamp's glow and the positions of the poles and trees remain essentially fixed, indicating no significant camera pan or object translation.
Minor fluctuations in the brightness/extent of the lamp halo and the illuminated rain are visible between frames.
outside_clip_unknowns: What the bright specks in the foliage are (illuminated raindrops, insects, or bokeh) is not determinable from the clip.
The intensity trend of the rain or the lamp before and after this excerpt is unknown.
uncertain_details: Whether the apparent motion of the streaks and specks is purely particle motion or includes slight handheld camera shake cannot be confirmed.
Exact nature of the distant lower light is unclear.
